cp.hint.always: Names (separated by ';') always zipped whole, with no limits. Default: node_modules.
cp.hint.subs: Each subfolder of these folders is zipped whole, with no limits. Default: profiles.
cp.hint.excl: Folders containing them are not zipped (separated by ';').
cp.tip.n: A folder is zipped if it contains MORE than this number of small files (direct files only).
cp.tip.k: Small = size strictly below this value.
cp.tip.merge: If a folder would contain only the zips of its subfolders (more than N entries), it is zipped once as a whole.
cp.tip.partial: If a folder meets N/K but is too large (or has big files), its small files are still packed into a "_piccoli.zip" inside the folder; the other files stay.
cp.tip.maxfolder: Larger folders are not zipped (avoids bundling big files: zipping does not speed up copying).
cp.tip.maxfile: A folder containing a file larger than this is not zipped.
cp.tip.mode: Automatic: already compressed files (jpg, mp4, zip…) are only stored, the others are compressed quickly.
cp.tip.subs: Folders with this name (e.g. profiles) are not zipped: one zip is created for each of their subfolders, without inspecting their contents or applying size limits.
cp.tip.always: Folders with this name are always zipped whole (e.g. node_modules), without inspecting their contents or applying size limits.
cp.tip.excl: Patterns separated by ';'. A folder containing them is not zipped.
cp.tip.preview: Shows what would be done, without touching any file.
cp.tip.run: Creates the zips, verifies them, then removes the original folders.
cp.tip.findzip: Separate path: searches the folder for zips created by NetSynq to turn them back into folders.
cp.tip.rpreview: Shows what would be restored, without touching any file.
cp.tip.rrun: Extracts and verifies the zips, then deletes them.
